title: Humans follow earth; earth follows heaven
subtitle: Daodejing, chapter 25
shortSummary: The line arranges humans, earth, heaven, the Dao and naturalness in a layered order that must be read in its received-text context.
curatorialDescription: ‘Dao follows naturalness’ is often detached as a lifestyle maxim. In chapter 25 of the Daodejing it belongs to a sustained discussion of naming and order.
researchNote: The Alpha entry uses the received chapter locator; excavated texts, received editions and major commentaries remain to be compared.

quote.original: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。
quote.interpretation: The chapter describes a layered relation of correspondence; it should not be reduced to the modern slogan ‘go with the flow’.
